start.title: La Voz de lo Alto
start.text:
Una voz llena el cielo.
"Noé, construye un arca. Se acerca un diluvio."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The voice fades. But the weight in your chest remains.
[TODO:es] Genesis 6:22 — Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
[TODO:es] No answer comes. Only the command remains.

mockery.title: Voces de la Multitud
mockery.text:
Los aldeanos se reúnen, riendo.
"¿Un barco? ¿Aquí? Estás loco, viejo."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your words only feed their mockery.
[TODO:es] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah kept building the ark, despite the world's mockery.
[TODO:es] They turn their backs. You are alone in faith.

building.title: Ciprés y Brea
building.text:
Años de sudor. La madera se parte. La brea sella.
Te duele la espalda, pero el arca se eleva.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Rest a while, the work is endless
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Doubt creeps in with the silence.
[TODO:es] Genesis 6:14-16 — Noah built the ark of cypress wood exactly as God instructed.

ark_done.title: Está Terminada
ark_done.text:
El arca se alza sobre ti.
Tu familia se reúne, en silencio ante la madera.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Pride poisons the work. You catch yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Thank God for the strength given
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 6:9 — Noah walked with God and gave Him thanks for every step.

animals.title: De Dos en Dos
animals.text:
Criaturas de todas las tierras vienen.
Leones junto a corderos. Águilas a tus pies.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Fear blinds you. God sent every one.
[TODO:es] Genesis 7:8-9 — The animals came to Noah two by two, and he received them.

boarding.title: La Puerta se Cierra
boarding.text:
Tu familia está dentro. Los animales se acomodan.
Dios mismo cierra la puerta.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Run back out to warn them again
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The door is sealed. The choice has been made.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Hold your wife's hand and wait
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 7:16 — The Lord Himself shut the door of the ark behind Noah.

storm.title: Los Cielos se Abren
storm.text:
La lluvia cae como nunca antes se había visto.
Las profundidades estallan. El mundo se ahoga.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The sound swallows your cry.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Trust that God is just and merciful
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 7:23 — Noah trusted God as the flood covered the earth.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Try to pull strangers from the water
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The door is sealed. There is nothing to be done.

inside.title: Cuarenta Días
inside.text:
El arca se mece. Los animales respiran.
Los días se difuminan. Solo queda el crujido de la madera.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 7:24 — Noah cared for his family and the animals through 150 days on the waters.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Sit alone and let despair grow
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The silence presses on you. Faith dims.

dove.title: La Paloma Regresa
dove.text:
Sueltas una paloma. Pasan las horas.
Regresa, con una hoja de olivo en el pico.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Even now, doubt fights to hold you.
[TODO:es] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned with an olive leaf — a sign of new life.

dry_land.title: Tierra Bajo Tus Pies
dry_land.text:
La puerta se abre. El sol entra a raudales.
Pisas barro cálido y vivo.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Rush to claim the new land
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The land was never yours to claim.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Kneel and build an altar to God
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 8:20 — Noah's first act on dry land was to build an altar to the Lord.

covenant.title: El Arcoíris
covenant.text:
Un arcoíris se extiende por el cielo.
"Nunca más. Este es mi pacto contigo."
